ux_valio.validators._native.doc: Optional native apply (product PyO3 ``ux_valio_native``). Not a taught import.

_FamilyDoor.doc: Private bind row for one closed family. Not a product type door.

_run_closed.doc: One FFI apply. Host formats KEEP wording. Extract miss stays on host.

_select.doc: Pair for this row. Compile and apply stay separate.

_bind_compiled_plan.signature: (owner: Any, native: Any, compile_fn: Any, bounds: dict[str, Any]) -> None

_bridge_to_ip.doc: Extract miss before native IP apply.

_bridge_to_length.doc: Extract miss before native length apply.

_bridge_to_type.doc: Extract miss before native type-door or member-set apply.

_bridge_to_value.doc: Extract miss before native value/bound apply.

_clear_native.doc: One host-fallback clear for the bind-time native bundle.

_closed_integer_enum_members.doc: Member ``i64`` values when the path is ``IntegerEnumValidator`` + type.

_closed_ip.doc: Compile kwargs when the path is an IP facade + the type door.

_closed_length.doc: Compile kwargs when the specified path is annotation + LengthValidator.
_closed_length.signature: (owner: Any, annotation: type) -> dict[str, int] | None

_closed_string_enum_members.doc: UTF-8 member values when the path is ``StringEnumValidator`` + type.

_closed_type_door.doc: Empty compile kwargs when only the type door is active.
_closed_type_door.signature: (owner: Any, annotation_matches: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None

_closed_value_bounds.doc: Compile kwargs when the specified path is annotation + ValueValidator bounds.
_closed_value_bounds.signature: (owner: Any, annotation: type, bound_type: type) -> dict[str, Any] | None

_extract_same.doc: Identity payload. StringEnum overrides this with member ``.value``.

_is_date_type_annotation.doc: Exact ``datetime.date``, or the facade coerce union ``date | str``.

_is_datetime_type_annotation.doc: Exact ``datetime.datetime``, or the facade coerce union ``datetime | str``.

_is_decimal_type_annotation.doc: Exact ``decimal.Decimal``, or the facade coerce union ``Decimal | str``.

_is_path_type_annotation.doc: Exact ``pathlib.Path``, or the facade coerce union ``Path | str``.

_is_stored_or_str_annotation.doc: Exact ``stored``, or the coerce union ``stored | str``.

_is_uuid_type_annotation.doc: Exact ``uuid.UUID``, or the facade coerce union ``UUID | str``.

_load_native.doc: Import the extra once. Failed install is host apply, not a hot-path error.

_raise_host_boolean_type_miss.doc: KEEP TypeError wording. Closed Boolean type door is host-first.

_raise_host_closed_type_miss.doc: KEEP TypeError wording for a closed Integer, Float, String, or Bytes plan.
_raise_host_closed_type_miss.signature: (owner: Any, value: Any, continue_unit: Any) -> None

_raise_host_enum_type_miss.doc: KEEP TypeError wording for a closed IntegerEnum or StringEnum plan.

_raise_host_length_type_miss.doc: KEEP TypeError wording for a closed String or Bytes plan.

_raise_host_type_door_miss.doc: KEEP TypeError wording for a closed type door that only forwards.

_raise_host_value_type_miss.doc: KEEP TypeError wording for a closed Integer or Float plan.

_raise_native_bound_miss.doc: Map native ``FailKind`` to Door A KEEP wording. Unexpected kind is infra.
_raise_native_bound_miss.signature: (owner: Any, fail: Any, value: Any) -> None

_read_ip_facade.doc: ``(kind, parser, label)`` for a closed IP facade. Else ``None``.

_read_owner_annotation.doc: Host isinstance type when the closed plan stores the annotation.

_recompile_closed_owners.doc: Refresh sealed set-phase lists after a plan bind or clear.

_reject_ip_string.doc: KEEP IP ``ValueError`` wording. Same text as ``_reject_unless_ip``.
_reject_ip_string.signature: (owner: Any, value: Any, parser: Any, label: str) -> None

apply_native_bounds.doc: Call the bind-time family run. Unset bundle is a caller bug.

bind_native_plan.doc: Compile at bind. No native module / unclosed path → ``_native_plan is None``.
